entry_points.text: Driver extension points comprise pinctrl group and mapping operations, platform probe, remove and power hooks, and PnP resource and power callbacks.
Pstore backend opens, reads, writes and erases records; ptdump observes page-table walks per level; relay requires create and remove with sub-buffer start voting continue or stop.
Disabled PTP registration yields null; resume clears the notify flag, runs task work and handles restartable sequences.
Callers consult a mediation hook per sensitive inode and path action and proceed on success.

exports.text: Without pin control, acquiring a handle or looking up a state yields null, selecting a state or power state reports success, and releasing does nothing.
GPIO lines report usable and accept requests with success while board mapping registration succeeds without storing and unregistration is empty.
Platform creation and driver registration delegate to core routines; with PnP disabled lookups yield null and start reports missing; profile init succeeds while recorders discard.
ACL chmod succeeds while set fails unsupported; firmware helpers test compatibility and read u32 values with device forms delegating to firmware nodes.
Without hardware, SEV status and dispatch report no-device, RAS consumer count is zero, PTP registration yields null and worker scheduling is unsupported.

Regulator acquisition yields null with tolerance widening from narrow to wide; regset skip advances without storing; relay appends with sub-buffer switch; bounded random is unbiased with power-of-two fast path.
Resctrl exposes default controls and iteration; resource lists add and iterate; ring buffers allocate by size; netlink send tolerates null; security capability and inode hooks allow or forward.
Reaction entry, shadow-stack allocation, writable-exec check and PTI init are inert success or null shims when unavailable.

hazards.text: Two names share 0x360c as aliases for one device value; machine and characteristic values are overloaded by architecture and context and need disambiguation.

Parsers must bound DOS message, directories and sections with eight-byte names possibly unterminated; null and success shims mask disabled builds; managed mapping yields invalid-argument pointers that callers must validate.
Spin waits with relaxation and no timeout; bounded random needs nonzero ceiling and range length underflows if end precedes start; skip before start and over-capacity reserve trigger bugs.

Validate and copy firmware blobs; RMID reads may sleep with interrupts enabled; alarms clamp to maximum; shadow-stack corruption traps on full use or magic mismatch; fallback security allows by default.

invariants.text: PCI vendor and device numbers are stable 16-bit identifiers matched as vendor plus device; 3400 LPC family spans inclusive MIN 0x3b00 to MAX 0x3b1f and must never be renumbered.
PE header is guarded with fixed signature and machine assignments; frame helper rounds up to page boundary; personality reader masks bits while writer stores to current task.
Mapping helpers build static dummy, mux and config entries with default shorthands; pin config packs selector in low 8 bits with 24-bit argument.
PnP read and write are gated on capability bits plus callbacks; without protection keys only key zero exists and allocation fails; platform suspend hook is null.
Project IDs compare raw values with invalid and overflow rules; property singletons inline values while bool sets name only; RCU free and refcount increment come from other dossiers.
Ftrace CPU packing, scaled-ppm conversion via 64-bit 125/8000, single-evaluation rate-limited warnings, domain validation on category match, and interleaved config indexing are fixed.
Reader bias is the top bit and writer the next with locked states derived from the counter; SCTP pads to four bytes; fallback hooks allow with flow match one.

locks.text: PPS spinlock serializes sequence, timestamps and queues; pstore staging uses a raw spinlock with mutex traversal; ratelimit init sets lock and interval with irqsave reset.
Ref-tracker init prepares lists, lock and budget; relay masks interrupts or pins the CPU around per-CPU buffer updates.
RTC operations serialize on a mutex with spinlock for irq state; rethook publishes via RCU; per-net rtnl delegates to global ops; realtime rw base pairs atomic counter with rt mutex.

state_machines.text: Combined helpers acquire plus activate by name with default shorthand in managed and unmanaged forms; success transfers ownership while failure releases partial state; clients move among default, init, idle and sleep.
Platform advances from registration through probe to active use with suspend and remove; PnP tracks active state; SEV firmware advances from uninitialized to initialized to working.

SEV platform moves init to operational to shutdown with guest launch and migration starts; ratelimit arms full then consumes and refills per window; relay fills sub-buffers then switches with produced and consumed counters.
Restart is single-shot per entry; ring uses data, pad and time-extend records for continuity; automaton monitor pairs enabled flag with state number and reset may pend before completion.

structs.text: DOS stub holds 16-bit words plus 32-bit PE offset; COFF header holds signature, machine and counts; optional header holds sizes, bases, subsystem and stack; section holds name, addresses and flags; certificate holds length, revision and type.

Pin map binds consumer, state, kind and controller with mux or config payload; kinds order invalid, dummy, mux, pin configs and group configs; pin and controller descriptors aggregate tables and operations.
Early Intel, audio and small-vendor PCI numbers are fixed interface facts; platform device IDs use -1 for none and -2 for auto.
Linux magic and EFI stub revision are fixed; section alignment occupies masked bits with stepped values; high bits encode cache, share and access flags; certificate types and revisions are fixed.

Platform devices combine name, ID, embedded device and resources; PnP devices and protocols carry identity, resources and callbacks with iteration; poison pointers derive markers from a base plus offsets.

ACL uses refcount with flexible entries; PPS tracks modes, timestamps and sequences; PR holds per-device ops; projid wraps u32; property entries carry types and values; PSCI defines standby and power-down with operations table.

SEV commands group platform, guest, launch, migration, debug and SNP ranges; init carries flags and memory; launch and migration carry handles, policies and blobs; attestation carries handle, report and nonce with bidirectional length.

PSP packs status, command and response with doorbell ring bit; pstore record holds kind, ID, buffer and ECC; PTP info holds caps, pins and callbacks; range is inclusive u64; ratelimit holds lock, window and burst with 5 and 10 defaults.

Regset describes geometry, notes and callbacks; regulator modes are bitmask-combinable; relay channel holds sizing, topology and callbacks at version 7; resctrl levels cover cache and bandwidth; RAID6 needs at least 4 disks.

Resctrl resource embeds cache, bandwidth and monitor records with domain lists; restart carries futex, sleep or poll state with resume callback; ring event packs short length with delta; rolling buffer tracks head and tail queues.

RTC device embeds operations, irq state, timer queue and limits; RV monitor links automaton with scopes and atom bitmaps; SCTP header carries ports, tag and checksum; LSM aggregates families; shadow stack ends with trailing magic.
